The Escape Room Chronicles, [b]over 1.5 million copies[/b] sold, returns refined for Steam!

We are thrilled to announce that [b]“The Escape Room Chronicles ep4:The 24-Hour TV Station”[/b] is now available for purchase on Steam!

Purchase during the first 14 days of launch to receive [b]20% off[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246260/

[h3]“ep4:The 24-Hour TV Station” Introduction[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320779/41e1615b9f122120847d7ad1c5057867cc43a514.jpg[/img]

The stage is set in an actual TV studio!

The protagonist is working as an assistant on a variety show featuring a famous host. After filming wraps up and the cast heads to the green room, our protagonist finishes packing up only to find that the studio doors won’t open!

An unexpected escape adventure begins from a world of lights, cameras, and live audiences.

Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery! The simple yet profound mysteries offer an irresistible thrill when solved.
